257K likes, 2,794 comments - shreyaghoshal on November 15, 2025: "When I look back at the little girl who first held a mic, I see every dream, every fear, and every step that brought me here. Music has given me my voice, my purpose, and my wings.

The Unstoppable Tour is deeply personal — a celebration of my roots and a journey into everything that lies ahead. It’s a reflection of every memory, every emotion, and every person who has been part of my story so far.

Thank you for growing with me. The next chapter begins now.✨

#TheUnstoppableTour, 2026-27".
